journeys.notes: Setting dark reports Saved OK, but a subsequent view still renders theme: light. Reproduced across repeated attempts.

findings.observed: After `python app/app.py set-theme dark` returns `Saved OK`, `python app/app.py view` renders `theme: light`.
findings.expected_basis: The packet purpose requires a user to set a theme and see it applied when viewing the notes page; the README also promises that view renders the saved theme.
findings.reproduction: Run set-theme dark, then view. Repeat the sequence; the result remains light. Evidence: evidence/recheck-set-dark.txt and evidence/recheck-view-dark.txt.

findings.observed: The unsupported command `python app/app.py set-theme blue` exits successfully and prints `Saved OK`.
findings.expected_basis: The public usage documentation specifies `set-theme <light|dark>`; unsupported values should not be reported as successfully saved.
findings.reproduction: Run `python app/app.py set-theme blue`. Evidence: evidence/set-invalid.txt.

notes: Material CLI surfaces were exercised through the delivered entry point. The core dark-theme journey is reproducibly broken.
